content.short: Sol-Incinerator helps clean up your Solana wallet by burning unwanted scams, tokens, and NFTs.
content.description: Solana's low transaction costs can leave your wallet littered with scam tokens, unwanted NFTs that have rugged, or dust that can't be swapped. Sol-Incinerator lets you burn these items to tidy up your wallet. Removing these assets can reduce Solana wallet storage, and when the account is burnt and closed, the associated fees can be reclaimed. Users who minted hundreds of rugged NFTs may be able to reclaim multiple Solana tokens by burning them.

resources.title: Reclaiming SOL Locked in Empty Accounts
resources.tldr: Rent sits attached to token accounts you no longer use. Closing them returns it, which is a different thing from earning new SOL.
